items.exampleEn: This phone is better than my old one.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機比我的舊手機好。

items.exampleEn: What is the difference between these two cups?
items.exampleZh: 這兩個杯子有什麼不同？

items.audioEn: I am not free today, but I am free on Sunday.
items.audioZh: 我今天沒空，但星期天有空。

items.sentenceEn: Is it true that you have a new job?
This box is light, but that one is heavy.
items.sentenceZh: 這個箱子很輕，但那個很重。

items.stemEn: This bag is very ____. I can carry it with one hand.
items.stemZh: 這個包包很輕，我一隻手就拿得動。

items.stemEn: I feel ____ today. Yesterday I was sick.
items.stemZh: 我今天覺得好多了，我昨天生病了。

items.passageEn: Leo and his brother look the same, but there is a big difference. Leo is strong, and he plays basketball every day. His brother is not strong, but hard math tests are easy for him. Leo says, "He is better at math, and I am better at sports."
items.passageZh: Leo 和他的兄弟長得一模一樣，但兩人有很大的差別。Leo 很強壯，每天打籃球。他的兄弟不強壯，但很難的數學考試對他來說很簡單。Leo 說：「他數學比較好，我運動比較好。」

questions.questionZh: Leo 的兄弟哪方面比較強？

referenceEn: Are you sure he is free today?
Are you sure that he is free today?
rubricZh: 「你確定嗎」用 Are you sure…?（後面可加 that，也可省略）
「有空」用 free（例如 he is free）

referenceEn: He swims better than I do.
rubricZh: better 是 well 的比較級，前面不再加 more
than 後面可寫，例如 than me、than I do 等
